item.title: NIPSCO CEO addresses rising electricity and gas bills in Northwest Indiana
item.description: Northwest Indiana residents have been saying their electricity and gas bills from NIPSCO have been getting higher and higher. Ahead of two scheduled protests outside NIPSCO's offices next week, NIPSCO CEO Vince Parisi responded to the outcry.
